dump_kernel.description: Attempt to dump kernel memory (/dev/kmem) rather than physical memory (/dev/mem). Warning: can lock up system.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for debugging purposes.

buffer_size.description: Number of bytes per memory read operation. Suffixes k, m, g supported. Default 0 uses page_size.

dump_size.description: Number of memory bytes to dump. Suffixes k, m, g supported. Default 0 dumps until EOF.

page_size.description: Use page_size as the memory page size. Suffixes k, m, g supported. Default 0 uses system page size.

map_file.description: Write the memory map to map_file. Specify '-' for stderr. Empty for no map file.
